invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object created by a static helper, so result should never be null.
getWriteStatuses() should return the write status list, which is expected to be initialized when returning from JavaWriteHelper.write.
The return type is parameterized as List<WriteStatus>, so getWriteStatuses() should produce a List.
Result is statically typed as HoodieWriteMetadata, but supporting inheritance is prudent.
